decisionSummary: The Aug 21 dev-publish v25/2.0.32 source is canonical. It is the direct forward fix from the reviewed rich miniPaint/Jinn peer line: it retains the unavailable-sandbox-mkdir repair and fixes the real Sandstorm resume path so a fresh Paint grain defaults explicitly to minipaint. It retains scoped read-only GrainContext integration for Jinn, the full PowerBox-gated image editor, and candidate-bound metadata aligned with the signed Bureau Paint identity. Main remains its reviewed stable ancestor; the divergent metadata and historical publish/codex refs are older package or release lines with no newer runnable Paint source.

checks: complete current remote-head snapshot reviewed; only dev-publish advanced from the prior receipt
clean tracked dev-publish source at the selected commit passed release-inputs and mutation controls for both the sandbox launcher and fresh-grain resume type
make build and make test passed, including 234 Python and integration tests
two independent selected-commit candidates matched SHA-256 7b0c872ce61e3e6678a95459e3b3f8ae10880c215c2d95043b56ea84e24ca21a and packageId 7b0c872ce61e3e6678a95459e3b3f8ae
the selected source metadata and package manifest agree on Bureau Paint v25/2.0.32 with an empty Store-gallery declaration

the v2.0.31 pilot grain proved governed authorization and provenance; its runtime log exposed the missing fresh-grain resume type, which this forward source repairs; governed publication and clean-tenant runtime retest remain required
